descriptions.english: At the start of each turn, add a random Ephemeral Construct to your hand.
descriptions.chinese: 每回合开始时，将一张具有短暂的随机造物置入手牌。

lore_tooltips.english: Scrolls bearing schematics for all manner of constructs, used by apprentice technicians to hone their craft.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 绘有各类造物设计图的蓝图卷轴，供新手技师们练习造物技术之用

descriptions.english: Each stack of [sanson.DevaClan_karmergy] grants an additional +5 attack.

lore_tooltips.english: Mysterious incense of unknown composition. It heightens the senses of those who breathe it in, amplifying pleasure.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 成分不明的神秘香料，能增强吸入者的感官能力，使得快感更加强烈

descriptions.english: When a friendly Construct dies, gain 1 [sanson.DevaClan_Charge].
descriptions.chinese: 友方造物死亡后，获得1点[sanson.DevaClan_Charge]。

lore_tooltips.english: Modified energy storage units built to reclaim every last scrap of power from discarded constructs.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 经过改装的蓄能装置，用于从废弃的造物身上回收最后一点能量

descriptions.chinese: 每场战斗开始时，获得5点[sanson.DevaClan_Charge]。

lore_tooltips.english: Deva technicians store harvested construct energy as emergency backup power.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 天人技师们会将从造物中回收的能量储存起来，以备不时之需

descriptions.english: After a friendly unit uses an ability, it gains +3/+3.
descriptions.chinese: 一个友方角色使用主动能力后，使其获得+3/+3。

lore_tooltips.english: This ceremonial bowl resonates with specific brainwaves, producing soothing, melodic tones.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 这个钵盂能与特殊的脑波产生共鸣，发出能令人平静下来的美妙声音

descriptions.english: After every 3 friendly unit abilities activated, draw 1 card.
descriptions.chinese: 友方单位每使用3次主动能力，抽1张牌。

lore_tooltips.english: A prayer-wheel device capable of storing massive volumes of information. Deva use it for rapid complex data processing.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 能储存大量信息的转经筒，天人用它来快速处理复杂的数据

descriptions.english: After a friendly Construct is [sanson.DevaClan_Reset], grant it Damage Shield 1.
descriptions.chinese: 友方造物被[sanson.DevaClan_Reset]后，获得伤害护盾1。

lore_tooltips.english: A dedicated protective module engineered by Nayuta for constructs, shielding them from harm during reset procedures.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 那由多为造物开发了一种专用的保护模块，能防止造物在重置过程中受到伤害

lore_tooltips.english: A portable battlefield server that drastically improves coordination between allied units.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 一台战场上使用的便捷式服务器，能大幅提升友军单位之间的协作效率

descriptions.english: Friendly unit abilities have a 25% chance to finish their cooldown immediately after use.
descriptions.chinese: 友方单位主动能力使用后有25%几率立刻结束冷却。

lore_tooltips.english: Some Deva implant this chip within their brain, transmuting fleeting flashes of insight into readily‑usable power.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 有些天人会在大脑里植入这种芯片，将偶然获得的灵感转化为易于使用的力量

descriptions.english: When Relentless begins on a floor, friendly units there gain [sanson.DevaClan_karmergy] 2.
descriptions.chinese: 一层进入不懈战时，该层友方角色获得[sanson.DevaClan_karmergy]2。

lore_tooltips.english: Seals bestowed by Mara Podian upon his Asura warriors. Merely gazing upon them stirs deep-seated bloodlust for battle.
lore_tooltips.chinese: 魔罗波甸赐予修罗战士们的印章，只要凝视它就会激起内心深处的战斗欲望
